issue.body:
I'm not sure this is a bug. I might be missing something. It seems that `UploadFile.file` is missing the `seekable` attribute, which prevents it from being used in `httpx`.

#### To Reproduce (quick)
```python
import starlette.datastructures
starlette.datastructures.UploadFile("hello").file.seekable # AttributeError
```
#### Where does it arise?
```python
import starlette.datastructures
import httpx
file = starlette.datastructures.UploadFile("hello").file
httpx.post("https://google.com", files={"file": file}) # AttributeError: 'SpooledTemporaryFile' object has no attribute 'seekable'
```

#### Is it a bug?
The reason why I think this might be a bug or good to add is that, for the example I provided, it is very easy to fix:
```python
import starlette.datastructures
import httpx
file = starlette.datastructures.UploadFile("hello").file
file.seekable = lambda: True
httpx.post("https://google.com", files={"file": file}) # Should return 405 Method Not Allowed
```
I'm not sure if this has any unintended consequences.

Another reason I think it's a bug is that `tempfile.TemporaryFile` has the attribute `seekable`.
issue.title: [Bug (?)] UploadFile: 'SpooledTemporaryFile' object has no attribute 'seekable'
